scope: F10 standard-library XLSX fallback workbook and worksheet binding only; not all cell features or all XLSX/package conformance.
changes: Require package root officeDocument relationship to xl/workbook.xml.
Reuse existing _ooxml_relationships, _require_ooxml_office_document_binding, _ooxml_xml_root and _xlsx_sheet_context before emitting any Evidence for the workbook-to-worksheet fan-out.
Require one nonempty direct canonical sheets list and use validated names/member mapping in workbook order. Remove loose local-name relationship attribute and guessed sheetN.xml fallback.
Read cells only along canonical direct worksheet/sheetData/row/c paths; require one direct sheetData. Inaccessible extension/foreign cell lookalikes do not become table_cell Evidence.
Keep fallback partial, existing numeric lexical precision, saved-formula status, sheet state and original hashes.
Root separately authorized a 6-line canonical root relationship addition to old write_minimal_xlsx fixture; all existing assertions/test logic unchanged.

test_safety.source_inputs: Synthetic temporary roots only; tests delete only their own TemporaryDirectory fixtures on cleanup.
test_safety.blocked: New focused suite guards HTTPConnection.connect and builder._ollama_json; visuals suppressed, password discovery empty, fingerprint synthetic, Paddle session nullcontext for build integration. No model/HTTP/OCR/Keychain/real documents.
test_safety.legacy_wrapper: Only two original test methods invoked with unrelated class setup/teardown bypassed. v2 guards HTTP/runtime metadata/subprocess.Popen and suppresses visual observations; actual test assertions and Reader behavior retained.

runs.result: 14 methods: 46 assertion failures + 1 test harness path canonicalization error. Preserved, not counted as product-only RED.

14 methods: 46 assertion/subtest failures, zero errors/skips, 0.278753 s. Integration already rolled failed sources back, but direct Reader emitted Evidence before late validation; package root missing was accepted.
17 methods PASS, zero skips, 0.277251 s. Includes root/type/mode/namespace/duplicate/target attacks, valid order/strict namespace/precision/formula/dispatch, and real 7-file downstream integration.
17 previously accepted generic XML/JSON methods PASS, zero skips, 0.228251 s.
2 original methods, 1 PASS + 1 ERROR. Existing precision fixture had no package root relationship. Failure explicitly retained, not PASS.
2 original methods PASS, zero skips, 0.177063 s. Only fixture package root metadata repaired, same assertions.

integration: build_intermediate_records.main -> process_file/ShardWriter -> both Intermediate Validators -> SearchUnit builder -> both SearchUnit Validators -> Local Memory adapter. 5 failed XLSX have zero Evidence/Relation/SearchUnit/semantic Evidence; good workbook remains partial and text neighbor success; all 7 source hashes unchanged.
limitations: No full OOXML conformance or Content_Types semantic validator, no all-cell-feature guarantee. Shared strings/styles/defined names and nested cell value namespace semantics remain existing separate parsing boundaries.
Worksheet sheetId duplicate handling reuses existing lexical ID check, not independent unsigned-integer schema replay; broad identity lexical validity is unverified.
Chartsheets and non-worksheet bindings reject this fallback rather than guessing cell parts.
Optional openpyxl native route unchanged. Only absence-of-openpyxl dispatch into the fallback is covered here.
No existing full Layer1PipelineTest class setup, package build, safe SQLite/answer, desktop sources, models, load tests or full product acceptance.
No source edits outside declared ownership, no commit/push/release; other working tree changes belong to their owners.
Runtime log artifacts are local ignored files; append-only executor record embeds exact result and log hashes. Independently verify referenced files.
rollback: If audit requires rollback, reverse only this F10 patch and the separately authorized fixture hunk, preserving earlier F08/F09 edits and all other owners' changes. Rebuild derived Reader artifacts after accepted parser code changes.
